name: Strength
description: Carries more, and cuts wood and stone faster.

name: Agility
description: Does every kind of work faster.

name: Intellect
description: Learns faster and is likelier to discover new things.

name: Vitality
description: Gets hungry and tired more slowly, and survives starvation longer.

name: Charisma
description: Makes friends easily, teaches well, and is likelier to lead.
